subject: English
passage: Diego Vargas and his team used satellite images of well-mapped areas of Phoenix to train a computer program to identify roof damage. When it was tested on images of Miami, it ______ identified damage in the vast majority of cases and even distinguished whether roofs had missing shingles or cracked tiles. Vargas believes the program will improve on this already-strong performance as it gets used more.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of the computer program's performance. In this context, 'consistently' means in a dependable, regular manner. The passage states that the program 'identified damage in the vast majority of cases' and characterizes this as 'already-strong' performance—both phrases indicate reliable, repeated success. The word 'consistently' precisely conveys this pattern of dependable operation across many instances.
